The rear bumper cover is cracked across its center and the trunk lid shows a crease near the latch, with the taillight housing
displaced on the driver's side. The pattern and height of this damage line up well with the impact that was reported, and nothing
in the inspection points to older or unrelated harm. The labor hours on the estimate are in line with what these repairs typically
take. The repair plan calls for replacing the bumper cover and taillight assembly, pulling and refinishing the trunk lid, and
checking the rear reinforcement for hidden deformation before final sign-off. Invoices submitted so far show no duplicated
charges, and the vehicle's history contains no prior damage to this area.
